affected_roles: all archived/deactivated users of any role, until their pre-archival token naturally expires

fix: No existing test exercised account archival against a held token -- all existing revocation tests (test_session_revocation.py) cover code-change and code-reset, both of which do bump token_version; archival was untested.
files_changed: Added test_token_rejected_after_account_archived to backend/tests/test_session_revocation.py; verified by re-applying the exact mutation in isolation and confirming the new test fails with assert 200 == 401, then reverting (diff-confirmed clean).
status: 1 new test; full suite 1211 passed, 5 skipped, 0 failures
